name: Fansipan
kicker: Cable car to the 3,143 m summit
summary: Cable car to the 3,143 m summit: ride 15–30 minutes, then the pagoda, for the ridge above town. Go when the ridge is clear. Weather can close the line. The ride is about 15 minutes, 15–20 minutes, or 30 minutes. An out-of-province adult is 750,000 đồng, or 850,000 đồng for a round trip.
timeNeeded: Check on arrival for a full visit
fee: Check on arrival. 750,000 đồng, or 850,000 đồng round trip.
getThere: Taxi or the Muong Hoa funicular to Hoang Lien station.
heroCaption: The summit platform, the stairs, and the flag above the cloud

notice.title: The cable ticket is one charge
notice.body: A scenic fee from 1 January 2025 is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Pay it beside the cable ticket. The funicular and the summit train are extra, and their prices are posted at the station.

body: The summit is 3,143 m. You ride the cable car from Nguyễn Chí Thanh, then walk the pagoda and the last steps, or take a separate summit train. The old walk takes two days, or two to three days. The cable ride is about 15 minutes, 15–20 minutes, or 30 minutes.

An out-of-province adult is 750,000 đồng, or 850,000 đồng for a round trip. A child over 1.4 m is 750,000 đồng. A child from 1 m to 1.4 m, or from 1 m to under 1.4 m, is 550,000 đồng. Under 1 m is free. Lao Cai residents are 550,000 đồng, 350,000 đồng, and free with papers. Prices change.

Hours are 7:30am–5:30pm every day, or 07:30–17:00, and they may change. From 28 September 2026, after maintenance above 3,000 m, Monday–Thursday departures run 8:00–14:30 with last return 16:00, Friday 8:00–15:30 with last return 17:00, Saturday 7:30–15:30 with last return 17:00, and Sunday 7:30–14:30 with last return 16:00. Read the board that morning.

figures.caption: A cabin over the terraces on the way up
figures.alt: A yellow and black Fansipan cable-car cabin above green rice terraces

gettingThere: The station is on Đường Nguyễn Chí Thanh, Sa Pa. Go by taxi or by the Muong Hoa funicular from Sun Plaza to Hoang Lien station. The funicular is about five minutes, with two tunnels and four viaducts, and it is sold on its own. The fare is at the station. The mountain is about 9 km southwest of town.

legs.heading: From the stone church
legs.body: Taxi or the funicular toward Hoang Lien station on Nguyễn Chí Thanh.

legs.heading: On foot, a different trip
legs.body: Three walking routes start in the park. Trạm Tôn is about 10.5 km, one day or two days and one night, the route most people use. Sín Chải is about 18 km over three days. Cát Cát is more than 12 km over three days. A trek price is separate from the cable ticket.

hours: 7:30am–5:30pm every day, or 07:30–17:00, and hours may change. From 28 September 2026: Monday–Thursday departures 8:00–14:30, last return 16:00; Friday 8:00–15:30, last return 17:00; Saturday 7:30–15:30, last return 17:00; Sunday 7:30–14:30, last return 16:00.
closed: Weather may close the line. Read the board that morning.
admissionNote: Out-of-province adult: 750,000 đồng, or 850,000 đồng for a round trip. Child over 1.4 m: 750,000 đồng. Child from 1 m to 1.4 m, or from 1 m to under 1.4 m: 550,000 đồng. Under 1 m: free. Lao Cai residents: 550,000 đồng, 350,000 đồng, and free with papers. A scenic fee from 1 January 2025, decision 4640, is 10,000 đồng from age 16 and 5,000 đồng from over 6 to under 16. Pay it beside the cable ticket. The cable is about 6 km, or 6,292.5 m.
